center.title: Collaboration
center.emptyHint: Share local content or a whiteboard, or enter a code to join someone else. You can also start collaboration from articles, cards, project documents, and whiteboards.
room.closedPendingError: {{reason}}. Unsynced changes remain on this device. Copy any content you need before clearing the cache.
room.offlinePending: Offline. Changes are saved on this device and will merge when reconnected.
room.offline: Offline. Other members’ changes are temporarily unavailable.
member.removeHint: This device will disconnect and lose access immediately. Content already saved on it is unaffected.
invitation.expires_other: Expires in {{amount}} days · Enter it in Join collaboration
invitation.expires_one: Expires in {{amount}} day · Enter it in Join collaboration
invitation.hint: Codes are valid for 7 days. Send one to invite a join request
invitation.rotateHint: The old code stops working immediately. Existing members are unaffected
invitation.rotated: Code rotated. The old code can no longer be used to request access
leave.discard.title: Clear local collaboration records?
leave.discard.description: The collaboration service is unreachable. Cached content will be preserved locally before this device’s sharing records are removed. Original content is kept.
leave.discard.label: Clear local records
leave.closed.title: Clear collaboration cache?
leave.closed.description: Sharing has ended. This device will no longer keep this collaboration cache.
leave.closed.label: Clear collaboration cache
leave.owner-pending.title: End sharing?
leave.owner-pending.description: Changes are still syncing. Wait for syncing to finish before ending sharing.
leave.owner-pending.label: End sharing
leave.member-pending.title: Leave collaboration?
leave.member-pending.description: There are unsynced changes. Wait for syncing to finish or discard them before leaving.
leave.member-pending.label: Leave collaboration
leave.owner.title: End sharing?
leave.owner.description: Collaboration will end for all members. Document content and attachments on the server will be cleared. Original content stays on this device.
leave.owner.label: End sharing
leave.member.title: Leave collaboration?
leave.member.description: This content will be removed from collaboration. Content saved locally is unaffected.
leave.member.label: Leave collaboration
control.point.code: Generate a 12-character code. Requests to join require your approval
control.point.local: Local blocks such as whiteboards and databases are not shared. Members see a placeholder
control.point.end: End sharing at any time. The server copy will be cleared
control.title: Content collaboration
control.hint: Share this content for live editing on other devices. It stays here so you can keep writing.
asset.hint: Videos are not uploaded to the collaboration server. Files missing on the contributor’s device cannot be shared either
asset.video: Video is not shared. It can only be played on the device that added it
asset.audio: Audio is not shared. It can only be played on the device that added it
control.pendingHint: Pausing local editing, uploading attachments, and creating the shared document…
